title: Comparing change goals and feasibility beliefs about changing social, emotional, and behavioral skills vs. personality traits among adolescents, parents, and teachers
review_rationale: SEB skills versus personality traits are a substantive focus of the study.
review_evidence: [pp. 2-3] The study directly compares change goals and feasibility beliefs for SEB skills and corresponding Big Five traits.
quantitative_scope_rationale: BESSI-derived items are repurposed to measure beliefs/goals about changing SEB skills, not participants' SEB skill levels/capacities.
meta_rationale: The quantitative constructs are change goals and feasibility beliefs rather than SEB skill level/capacity.
meta_evidence: [p. 5] The BESSI-45 was systematically modified for skill/trait change goals and feasibility beliefs.

issue_summary: Do BESSI-derived items repurposed to assess change goals/feasibility beliefs count as eligible SEB quantitative measurement?
ai_recommendation: Ineligible for meta-analysis because the measured construct is beliefs/goals about SEB skills rather than SEB skill level/capacity.
decision_options: eligible as modified BESSI;ineligible because target construct is not SEB skill level/capacity
adjudication_notes: BESSI-derived content measures beliefs/change goals, not levels of SEB skills; therefore it is quantitatively ineligible.
